name: rea
description: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) by morluto, wrapped by FrameCore Works: evidence-backed reverse engineering of apps, sites and binaries you may analyse, through the pinned rea-agents 6.5.0 MCP server. No setup command, no unpinned packages.

interface.longDescription: Reverse engineering of apps, sites and binaries you own or may examine, with REA by morluto through the pinned rea-agents 6.5.0 MCP server. Every finding comes with its evidence and unknowns. Needs Node.js 22.19+; native binaries need Ghidra, IDA or Hopper installed by you.
